name: Pumpkin
description: Pumpkin is a highly nutritious, low-calorie autumn staple. Loaded with vibrant carotenoid antioxidants, skin-loving vitamins, and hydrating minerals, this versatile whole food provides exceptional structural benefits for systemic immunity and vision preservation.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: An incredibly low-calorie and water-dense food, perfect for volume eating and weight management.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: Minimal protein content; provides trace non-essential amino acids standard in cucurbitaceous plants.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Virtually fat-free, making it an excellent base for heart-healthy and low-fat dietary regimes.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Composed of complex carbohydrates and natural sugars, yielding a low glycemic load that keeps insulin spikes minimal.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin A (Beta-Carotene)
microNutrients.description: Abundant in pro-vitamin A carotenoids (giving it the orange hue), which the body converts into retinol to shield eye health and enhance cellular repair.

microNutrients.name: Potassium
microNutrients.description: A vital systemic electrolyte that aids in smooth muscle contraction, healthy vascular tone, and balancing intra-cellular fluid levels.

microNutrients.name: Dietary Fiber
microNutrients.description: Though modest in raw flesh, its soluble fibers break down into gentle fuel for gut microbes and smooth out intestinal transit.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin C
microNutrients.description: An essential water-soluble antioxidant that promotes white blood cell synthesis, skin elasticity, and optimal iron absorption.

microNutrients.name: Lutein
microNutrients.description: Powerful plant pigment that deposits directly in the macular retina, filtering high-energy blue light and mitigating oxidative cell degeneration.

microNutrients.name: Zeaxanthin
microNutrients.description: Works in synergetic combination with lutein inside the eye tissue, absorbing scattering wavelengths to sustain sharp visual resolution.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin E
microNutrients.description: A fat-soluble antioxidant that collaborates with Vitamin C to safeguard cell membranes from environmental oxidative stressors.

healthBenefits: Ocular & Vision Protection: The rich combo of beta-carotene, lutein, and zeaxanthin builds a natural defense shield in the retina, reducing risks of long-term age-related macular degradation and cataracts.
Immune Defense Reinforcement: High doses of Vitamin A, paired with Vitamin C, optimize cellular mucosal barriers and accelerate white blood cell proliferation against external pathogens.
Cardiovascular Smoothness: The healthy presence of potassium and low sodium coordinates blood vessel relaxation, allowing for balanced fluid dynamics and blood pressure management.
Metabolic Weight Management: Being roughly 90% water, it provides a high-volume food structure that fills the stomach and promotes prolonged satiety with very minimal baseline calories.
precautions: Commercial Dynamic Overload: While pure pumpkin is highly metabolic, seasonal commercial items (like pumpkin pies or sweetened purees) are heavily packed with processed sugars, fats, and chemical binders.

Mild Diuretic Influence: Due to its high water and potassium metrics, pumpkin acts as a mild natural diuretic. Individuals taking specific metabolic medications (like lithium) should monitor structural intake values.

Carotenemia Profile: Consuming massive quantities of pumpkin over a prolonged period can store extra beta-carotene under the skin, temporarily turning the palms and soles of the feet a slight yellow-orange hue (harmless and reversible).

Gastrointestinal Adaptation: For individuals with highly sensitive digestive tracts or during flare-ups of chronic gut issues, large portions of cooked squash may occasionally trigger mild bloating due to its complex carbohydrate fibers.
